SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, agent_id AS agentId, agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, orch_run_id AS orchRunId, item_id AS itemId, seq, tool_name AS toolName, action_class AS actionClass, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json AS argsJson, change_set_json AS changeSetJson, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until AS validUntil, records, amount_micros AS amountMicros, approval_id AS approvalId, receipt_json AS receiptJson, undo_deadline AS undoDeadline, undone_by AS undoneBy, undo_reason AS undoReason, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM trust_action WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trust_action ( id, workspace_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, thread_id, turn_id, orch_run_id, item_id, seq, tool_name, action_class, risk, reversibility, status, gate, args_json, change_set_json, fingerprint, estimated, valid_until, records, amount_micros, approval_id, receipt_json, create_at, update_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{agentId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{threadId}, #{turnId}, #{orchRunId}, #{itemId}, #{seq}, #{toolName}, #{actionClass}, #{risk}, #{reversibility}, #{status}, #{gate}, #{argsJson}, #{changeSetJson}, #{fingerprint}, #{estimated}, #{validUntil}, COALESCE(#{records}, 0), #{amountMicros}, #{approvalId}, #{receiptJson}, now(), now() )
